messages:
Maya Patel: heads up — Customer ZED's renewal invoice  INV-2026-842 shows a platform fee line that doubled from the quote and the support tier is billed as 'Enterprise' even though they signed the Standard support amendment. Can someone look? :eyes:

Kevin Zhou: can you paste the invoice lines and subscription id? I'll pull the metering.

Maya Patel: sure — subscription: ZED-ONPREM-09. invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-842
Customer: ZED Corp
Subscription: ZED-ONPREM-09
1x Private Deployment (reserved GPUs) - $45,000/year
Platform Fee - $18,000/year
Support - Enterprise Tier - $12,000/year
Credit: -$0.00
Total Due: $75,000
```
We expected platform fee $9k (per quote) and Support = Standard $6k. They signed amendment on 2026-02-15 (Sara has copy).

Billing Bot: invoice INV-2026-842 generated by billing-service at 2026-06-09T11:06:40Z.

Oliver (Finance): quick notes: two possibilities — a proration/true-up added platform fee for added reserved pools during the term, or SKU mapping in the billing catalog defaulted to enterprise support. Do we have the amendment uploaded to the contract? Quote number? Contract clause on platform fee (annual vs first-year) matters here.

Sara K.: customer emailed signed amendment that downgrades support to Standard and keeps the same private deployment capacity. I uploaded the signed PDF to the CRM under ZED-642 on 2026-02-16. They specifically asked for no price increase on the platform fee in the renewal call.

Kevin Zhou: i'm pulling metering now. quick check — there were two extra reserved pools added on 2026-03-10 and 2026-04-02 for a short trial window. Meter logs show 2 *reserved_pools* active for 45 and 60 days respectively. That generated a usage true-up which the resolver applied as a one-off platform fee add-on. log excerpt:
```
2026-03-10 09:12:07 ZED-ONPREM-09 reserve_pool create pool_id=rp-44
2026-04-02 14:01:22 ZED-ONPREM-09 reserve_pool create pool_id=rp-51
2026-05-15 00:00:00 billing-run trueup platform_fee_delta=+9000
```

Maya Patel: OK — so the true-up explains +9k platform fee. That still leaves the support tier line showing Enterprise instead of Standard. That sounds like catalogue mapping bug.

Oliver (Finance): proposal: 1) credit the +9k platform fee true-up because sales approved the trial and it was supposed to be covered under the renewal terms, 2) reissue invoice with support = Standard ($6k) and platform fee = $9k (per quote) and show an explicit credit of $12k to net to expected total, 3) document decision in billing notes and CLM. Approve?

Sara K.: I approve the credit. Customer has the signed amendment; they made the trial request verbally and sales confirmed coverage. I'll attach the email thread to the invoice. :thumbsup:

Kevin Zhou: I'll run the credit and re-generate the invoice today. will add a memo: "credit for approved trial pools + support tier correction".

Maya Patel: thanks — can finance confirm whether we need RB approval for >$10k credit? Oliver?

Oliver (Finance): we can approve up to $25k as credit for contract-correcting reasons. no exec sign-off needed. proceed. :white_check_mark:

Billing Bot: credit GC-2026-334 created for INV-2026-842 amount $12,000. new invoice INV-2026-842-R issued.

Maya Patel: perfect. I'll message the AE to confirm customer receipt and close the loop.

Kevin Zhou: done — metering notes appended and invoice reissued. closing thread.
